note: General encouragement, not scripture. Each quote names its author and work; proverbs have no author and show as Unknown.

quotes.text: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant
quotes.source: The Story of Philosophy (1926), summarising Aristotle

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short space of time, but that we waste much of it.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.source: On the Shortness of Life, 1, tr. John W. Basore

quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: What you do every day matters more than what you do once in a while.
quotes.author: Gretchen Rubin

quotes.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt
quotes.source: An Autobiography (1913), quoting Squire Bill Widener

quotes.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Laozi

quotes.text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: No great thing is created suddenly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy

quotes.text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
quotes.author: Søren Kierkegaard

quotes.text: The best way out is always through.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.text: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.text: Attention is the beginning of devotion.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver

quotes.text: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.text: Think of all the beauty still left around you and be happy.
quotes.author: Anne Frank
quotes.source: The Diary of a Young Girl, 7 March 1944

quotes.text: Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees on a summer's day, listening to the murmur of the water, or watching the clouds float across the sky, is by no means a waste of time.
quotes.author: John Lubbock

quotes.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
quotes.author: Aesop
quotes.source: The Tortoise and the Hare (traditional moral)

quotes.text: Be not afraid of growing slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Little strokes fell great oaks.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that's the stuff life is made of.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Laozi
quotes.source: Tao Te Ching, ch. 64 (common English rendering)

quotes.text: Well begun is half done.
Little by little, one travels far.
